_real_world.variant_scope: Type 901 (Fuyu) AOE; also used for Type 903A per the repo's convention of reusing a generic navigation-radar module for auxiliary/logistics hulls without a combat sensor suite.
public_equipment: navigation radar (no combat sensor suite publicly reported for this hull type)

_provenance.modeling_note: No combat sensor suite is publicly reported for Type 901 or Type 903A; the OOB's Platform Parameters table for both hulls lists only self-defence armament (CIWS) and logistics fields, no radar. This module follows the repo's own convention (CSG_US_Oiler_Navigation_Radar on taoe6_supply.json) of giving an auxiliary/logistics ship a generic navigation-radar sensor_ref rather than a sourced combat radar, since none exists for this hull type in any tier.
